libero.note: Install simulator-only dependencies from requirements-libero.txt; do not install LIBERO's historical full requirements file.

opsd.note: Algorithm and configuration reference only. The inspected revision has no repository license file, so Resilient uses a clean adaptation and does not copy OPSD source.

fpo.note: The outcome-FPO objective is an independent PyTorch adaptation of the Apache-2.0 Playground implementation; MuJoCo and JAX runtime code is not vendored.
